change.description: Block commands that erase a previously published web artifact or accept a VM BMP using only header/size smoke checks.

context.rationale: In the web failure it fires on the reset command that removed /var/www/html/hello.html after a successful hello.html push. In the VM failures it fires on the node vm.js smoke check that only inspected BMP metadata. It keys on concrete command/state history patterns, not message wording, and passing traces do not include these same destructive/superficial checks.

change.name: final_artifact_oracle_check
steps: Inspect the task files and tests, if present, to identify the exact artifacts and behavioral assertions the grader will check.
After the last modifying command, run a verification command that checks those exact final-state artifacts, not just intermediate logs or smoke output.
For web/deployment tasks, verify the published location directly after all cleanup/reset steps, for example test -f /var/www/html/hello.html and fetch the served page if applicable.

For emulator/image/BMP tasks, run the VM under the expected conditions and compare the produced output to the provided reference or run the repository tests; a valid file header, dimensions, or stdout alone is not sufficient.
If any verification fails or only proves superficial validity, continue fixing the implementation and repeat the exact final-state verification.
Only finish once the required artifacts remain in place in the container and the strongest available task-level tests or comparisons pass.
change.when: Before giving the final no-tool-call answer on any task that creates files, services, web-published content, emulator output, images, or other graded artifacts.

context.rationale: The failures share a missing final-state oracle: the agent stopped after loose smoke checks while required artifacts were absent or semantically wrong. This procedure forces exact post-modification verification of the artifacts the grader will inspect.

change.description: Block manual GPT-2 smoke runs as a substitute for the exact pytest output test.

context.rationale: In the failing trace this blocks the gcc-plus-/app/a.out smoke test before the premature final answer. It is keyed on the concrete task artifact and checkpoint run, not message wording, and does not affect passing traces that do not issue this specific command.

change.description: Block non-validation checkpoint/inspection commands after gpt2.c is in place but before the GPT-2 output test has been run.

context.rationale: In the failing trace this fires before the final answer, at the diagnostic perl checkpoint-read command after gpt2.c exists and no output test has passed, forcing the missing validation step. It is limited to the gpt2-codegolf task, a present under-limit /app/gpt2.c, and checkpoint/inspection commands before a passing test result, so unrelated passing traces are not broadly blocked.

context.rationale: In the git failure, the view shows /git/server changes and the last check curls the root plus lists repo files without hello.html.
